encoding: 8-bit RGB PNG, lossless, sRGB chunk; sRGB code values, full range 0-255 in the file
orientation: x right, y down; (0,0) is the top-left pixel

interpretations.correct: decoded = file value (full-range source, or limited-range source correctly expanded)
interpretations.not_expanded: limited-range signal decoded as full: 16 + round(v*219/255)
interpretations.expanded_twice: full-range signal expanded as limited: clamp(round((v-16)*255/219))
